paragraphs: Rav Idi bar Shimi: Chullin 26a. Rabbah bar Shimi: Pesachim 6b.

notes.text: כו./ו:/כז: give Chullin 26a/Pesachim 6b/Keritot 27b by convention, without fresh edition checks. Earlier machine כג and damaged ו marker differ from the supplied text.

Rav Shimi bar Abba has no supplied citation; none is invented. This heading groups four attestations, not a single identified father. Full רב remains Rav for Idi, Shmuel and Shimi; רבה is the name Rabbah, without a separate title added.
